>Reverts changes from [ACM-29247](https://redhat.atlassian.net/browse/ACM-29247) / [ACM-29261](https://redhat.atlassian.net/browse/ACM-29261) / ACM-29244.

## Walkthrough The Renovate configuration file is updated with reformatted array fields using multi-line JSON arrays for improved readability. Functionally, the `gomod` manager is removed from `enabledManagers`, its entire configuration block is deleted, and two related `packageRules` entries targeting the `gomod` manager are removed. ## Changes |Cohort / File(s)|Summary| |---|---| |**Renovate Configuration**
`renovate.json`|Reformatted array fields (`labels`, `tekton.fileMatch`, and multiple `packageRules` fields) to multi-line format.
